body.p: The AI Translator view is the main interface for managing translation tasks in the Oxygen XML application. It provides a complete task management system that lets you create, monitor, and control translation jobs, with real-time status updates and detailed progress tracking.If the view is not open, select AI Translator from the Window Show View menu.

dlentry.dd: Opens the New Translation Task dialog box, where you can create a new task.

Provides access to the following options:
Preferences Opens the Preferences dialog box, where you can configure various options for the AI Translator.
Clear cache Clears the translation cache.

body.p:
The main panel displays all translation tasks and includes the following information for each task:
Task Name - The descriptive name of the translation job.
Progress Bar - A visual indicator that shows the completion percentage and the current file being processed.
Status Badge - A color-coded status indicator (Queued, Running, Stopped, Completed).
Task Details - The creation date, progress information, and duration.
The following actions are available in the main panel, depending on the task status:

dlentry.dd: Removes the task from the list.

dlentry.dt: Save Translated XLIFF (available for Completed tasks)
dlentry.dd: Saves the current translation work as an XLIFF file on your computer.

body.p: The following context menu actions are available when you right-click a task box:

dlentry.dd: Restarts the task from the beginning by using the updated files from disk. This lets you rerun the translation process with any changes made to the XLIFF, custom instructions file, or TMX files since the task was originally created.
Removes the task from the list.
Creates a new task with the same information as the selected task (user instructions, translation memory, XLIFF files, and the AI model configuration used).

dlentry.dt: Retry Fails Translations (available for Completed tasks)
dlentry.dd: Allows you to create a new task with different settings and instructions to retry the failed translation units.
Opens the task configuration dialog box, where you can modify the task settings, including the AI configuration selection, custom instructions, and translation memory options.
Saves a log file with detailed information about task execution, the current status, and any problems encountered.

dlentry.dt: Save Translated XLIFF (available for Completed tasks)
dlentry.dd: Saves the current translation work as an XLIFF file on your computer.

dlentry.dt: Save Intermediate Translated XLIFF (available for Stopped or Failed tasks)
dlentry.dd: Saves the current translation work as an XLIFF file on your computer after some parts have been translated.

section.title: Task Status States
section.p: Translation tasks progress through various states during their lifecycle:

ul.li:
Queued - The task is created and waiting to be processed.
Shows the creation timestamp.
The task is in the processing queue.

Running - The task is currently being processed.
Displays real-time progress (e.g. "15/400 translation units").
Shows the current file being processed.
Provides the estimated time remaining.
Updates the elapsed processing time.

Stopped - The task has been paused or interrupted.
Shows the last update timestamp.
Can be resumed by using the play button.
Preserves the current progress.

Completed - The task has finished successfully.
Shows the completion timestamp and total duration.
Displays the final statistics (e.g. "400/400 translation units").
Task remains in the history for reference purposes.

section.title: Caching Mechanism
section.p: The AI Translator add-on includes a caching system that stores AI translation responses locally to optimize performance, reduce costs, and improve the overall translation experience.

ul.li: Cost Reduction - By caching AI engine responses, the system significantly reduces API calls to external services such as OpenAI, resulting in lower usage costs for repeated translation requests.
Performance Improvement - Cached translations are retrieved instantly from local storage, eliminating network latency and API response times for previously translated content.
Consistency - The caching mechanism ensures that identical translation requests always return the same results, providing consistent and reproducible translations across multiple runs.

section.p:
The caching configuration is managed through the AI Translator Preferences dialog box. You can access preferences using the following methods:
From the Oxygen AI Translator view - Select Preferences from the Settings drop-down.
From the Oxygen menu - Go to Options Preferences Plugins AI Translator .
You can clear the cache from the Oxygen AI Translator view by using the Clear cache action from the Settings drop-down.
Clearing the cache can be useful after significant changes to AI model configurations or when you experience inconsistent translation results.
